tools.name: search_prep_centers
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find, compare, or filter Amazon FBA prep centers by name, US state, country, operator type, hazmat capability, or sales-tax-free location. Returns editorially verified centers with the date each was last verified and a link to its full profile. Do not use this for gen

tools.name: get_prep_center
tools.description: Use this to look up the full verified record for a single Amazon FBA prep center by its slug, after search_prep_centers has returned that slug. Do not guess slugs.

tools.name: get_directory_summary
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many Amazon FBA prep centers exist in this directory, what countries or operator types are covered, or how current the verification is. Returns published counts by country and operator type.
